rootCause.errorObserved: Update check error: Could not fetch a valid release JSON from the remote
rootCause.explanation: GitHub dynamically resolves /releases/latest/ to the published latest stable release (v1.0.2). Because latest.json was omitted from v1.0.2 assets, Tauri updater receives 404 and throws Error::ReleaseNotFound.
